headline.title: New plants & capacity expansion sets the pace
headline.text: 2 organisations announced new plants & capacity expansion in the last 30 days, none in the 30 days before; acquisitions, sales & investments (1) follows.

themes.description: Building new plants, logistics sites and data centres, or expanding existing core facilities to add capacity.
Buying, selling or carving out businesses, taking minority stakes, and managing integration or separation after deals.

stories.title: Europastry will open a cold-chain logistics facility in 2027 at Barcelona City Hub, developed by Goodman on the former Nissan factory grounds
stories.summary: The site is in the Zona Franca district of Barcelona, Catalonia, near the port and Mercabarna. The building covers 8,937 square metres, including 7,403 square metres of storage at -22 ºC and a 1,000 kWp solar plant. The opening is planned for 2027.

host_note.name: Rafael Ruiz
host_note.text: When a food producer invests in a new line, launches a product or enters a new market, packaging decisions made early can have a direct impact on efficiency, launch timing and supply continuity. At LCL, we work alongside our customers from the beginning to develop packaging that is ready for the operation, not adapted to it afterwards.

default_offer.body: From structural design and digital printing to export formats, sustainable packaging and supply continuity, LCL works alongside food producers to turn packaging into an enabler of growth.
